key_insight: G2Rec unifies global user co-engagement structure and semantic tokenization to produce more accurate user interest prototypes for generative recommendation.
engineering_relevance: The approach is designed for industrial-scale sequential recommendation, making it relevant for large recommender systems that need scalable context modeling.
method: Builds a holistic graph-based model of user co-engagement across interactions.
Tokenizes item semantics with explicit supervision signals to avoid heuristic-only representations.
Combines graph structure and semantic grounding into a unified generative recommendation framework.
evidence_signal: The paper reports online deployment across product surfaces and extensive experiments on public datasets showing superiority over existing methods.
watch_item: Deployment may require careful handling of scalability, graph construction cost, and the quality of learned semantic tokens in changing production data.
paper_title: Structuring and Tokenizing Distributed User Interest Context for Generative Recommendation
